rca_of_issue.root_cause: The outer `.cometchat` element (direct child of `.chat-view-messages`) expands to height:fit-content due to CometChat internal CSS applying `height:fit-content !important`. This cascades: .cometchat → .cometchat-message-list → .cometchat-message-list__body → .cometchat → .cometchat-list → .cometchat-list__body ALL expand to the full content height (1451px for 10 msgs). Meanwhile .chat-view-messages has overflow:hidden at 504px. The visible area shows only the FIRST 504px (oldest messages). The CSS fix only adds overflow-y:auto to .cometchat-message-list__body, but that element is also 1451px tall with no overflow to trigger.
rca_of_issue.why_current_fix_fails: overflow-y:auto on .cometchat-message-list__body has no effect because the element ITSELF is 1451px tall — the content fits perfectly, so there is no overflow. The element would need a FIXED/MAX height smaller than its content to create real overflow.

key_DOM_findings.cometchat-message-list__body: height=1450.92px, overflow-y=auto (CSS fix IS applied but useless at this size)
key_DOM_findings.cometchat-list: height=1450.92px, overflow=hidden (blocks native CometChat scroll too)

rca_of_issue.fix_needed: Constrain .chat-view-messages > .cometchat to 100% height with !important to override CometChat's fit-content. AND make the actual scroll container (ideally .cometchat-list__body or .cometchat-message-list__body) have a real fixed height that is smaller than content. Proposed CSS: `.chat-view-messages > .cometchat { height: 100% !important; max-height: 100% !important; overflow: hidden !important; }` AND `.chat-view-messages .cometchat-message-list { height: 100% !important; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }` AND ensure .cometchat-list has `height: 100% !important; overflow: hidden !important;`
reproduction_steps: 7. User sees: first/oldest messages at top, NOT the newest at bottom

action_items: CRITICAL: Add CSS to constrain the outer .cometchat wrapper height: `.chat-view-messages > .cometchat { height: 100% !important; max-height: 100% !important; overflow: hidden !important; }` — this is the key missing fix

CRITICAL: Also add: `.chat-view-messages .cometchat-message-list { height: 100% !important; }` and `.chat-view-messages .cometchat-list { height: 100% !important; overflow: hidden !important; }` to ensure the constraint cascades all the way down

IMPORTANT: After adding height constraints, the scrollToBottom JS should target `.cometchat-list__body` (CometChat's native scroll container) OR `.cometchat-message-list__body` — both need to have real overflow after the fix
VERIFY: After adding the CSS fix, confirm scrollH > clientH on at least one element in the chain, then confirm scrollTop = scrollH - clientH
